html:
You have officially joined the elite team of "Star Wipers"! You now have a unique opportunity to begin your galactic adventure in one of the most demanding sectors of space. Your mission? Cleaning! Alongside your trusted crew, you will embark on exciting expeditions to abandoned space stations, ruined restaurants in the cosmos, and unexplored planets.

Recruit, your task is not just cleaning – it's a battle against chaos! You must transform every damaged place into something perfectly clean, as if it were brand new. What can you expect? Armed with a mop, you’ll fight stains in unusual colors – red, green, and blue liquids that look more like alien substances than regular blood.

No good cleaner works alone! Gather your crew and take off together to traverse the vast expanse of the universe. Complete missions, tackle challenges, and collect resources to upgrade your gear, acquiring more powerful tools to fight the chaos!

Abandoned space stations hide dark secrets... And among them – dangerous, terrifying creatures! Dive into their world, uncover hidden weaknesses, and face unknown threats in a fight for survival.

Physics, physics, physics... The entire game is built around delightful, dynamic physics! Stack towers made of alien body parts, spill water from a bucket, or watch as trash flies out of boxes, leaving a mess all over the floor. Every action brings a new, fun twist to the chaos!
